title: Hana Likes Food
gist_ar: هنا بتحكي عن أكلها وشربها المفضل.
text: Hana likes food from her country. In the morning she drinks tea with sugar. She eats bread and cheese and one egg. She does not drink coffee. For lunch she eats rice with chicken and vegetables. She likes fish too. Her favourite fruit is the orange. Hana is thirsty now. There is some juice in the kitchen, but there isn't any milk.

questions.q: What does Hana drink in the morning?
What does she eat for lunch?
Is there any milk in the kitchen?
